name: Typewriter
description: Text that types itself letter by letter with a blinking cursor, and can erase itself again; the finished line is centred.

controls.name: Cursor
controls.description: Solid while typing; blinks while it waits.

controls.name: Erase
controls.description: Delete the text again (at twice Speed), done 0.3 s before Duration.

controls.name: Position
controls.description: Centre of the finished line, in frame pixels (9x16: [540, 960]).

controls.name: Max Width
controls.description: Widest the line may be, in pixels (9x16: 929); a wider one shrinks to fit.

controls.name: Shadow
controls.description: Strength of the soft shadow under the text, 0 to 100.

controls.name: Start
controls.description: When the first letter is typed, in seconds; the cursor blinks before it.

controls.name: Duration
controls.description: Length of the rendered clip in seconds.
